fullPassage:
Samoa is a Polynesian island country, consisting of two main islands (Upolu and Savai'i), located in the South Pacific. It is known for its year-round warm tropical weather, stunning beaches, and gorgeous waterfalls. Samoa even served as one of the sources of inspiration for the directors of the movie Moana released in 2016. It is a stunning island country that preserves its traditions, history, and distinct way of life.
A "fale" is a traditional Samoan house, with round-shaped thatched huts, supported by wood columns, but with no walls. The architecture of fale is very well-suited to the Samoan tropical climate. Its open-sided structure not only allows air to circulate freely to keep the space cool but also allows strong winds to pass through, enabling it to resist extreme weather events. The unique structure of the fale mirrors the Samoan people's values of openness and community. Its open structure allows people to come and go freely, creating a sense of belonging.
Samoa and American Samoa are different countries, even though they are next to each other in the South Pacific Ocean. Although these two countries used to be in the same time zone, the situation completely changed in 2011. On December 29, 2011, Samoans skipped December 30, and went straight to December 31, jumping 24 hours into the future. This happened because the Samoan government decided to switch sides of the International Date Line. This was to align the time with New Zealand, Australia, and other Asian countries, to improve their business transactions. Samoa is now on the opposite side of the International Date Line from American Samoa. They are just half an hour apart by flight, but there is a 24-hour time difference between them. If you fly from Samoa to American Samoa, in about 30 minutes you will return to yesterday!

팔레의 열린 구조는 사모아인들이 공동체를 중시한다는 것을 보여준다.
팔레의 벽 없는 구조는 건축 기술의 부족을 의미한다.
questions.passage:
Samoa is a Polynesian island country, consisting of two main islands (Upolu and Savai'i), located in the South Pacific. It is known for its year-round warm tropical weather, stunning beaches, and gorgeous waterfalls. Samoa even served as one of the sources of inspiration for the directors of the movie Moana released in 2016. It is a stunning island country that preserves its traditions, history, and distinct way of life.
A "fale" is a traditional Samoan house, with round-shaped thatched huts, supported by wood columns, but with no walls. The architecture of fale is very <u>well-suited</u> to the Samoan tropical climate. Its open-sided structure not only allows air to circulate freely to keep the space cool but also allows strong winds to pass through, enabling it to resist extreme weather events. The unique structure of the fale mirrors the Samoan people's values of openness and community. Its open structure allows people to come and go freely, creating a sense of belonging.
Samoa and American Samoa are different countries, even though they are next to each other in the South Pacific Ocean. Although these two countries used to be in the same time zone, the situation completely changed in 2011. On December 29, 2011, Samoans skipped December 30, and went straight to December 31, jumping 24 hours into the future. This happened because the Samoan government decided to switch sides of the International Date Line. This was to align the time with New Zealand, Australia, and other Asian countries, to improve their business transactions. Samoa is now on the opposite side of the International Date Line from American Samoa. They are just half an hour apart by flight, but there is a 24-hour time difference between them. If you fly from Samoa to American Samoa, in about 30 minutes you will return to yesterday!

det.korean: 팔레의 열린 구조가 사모아인들의 개방성과 공동체 가치를 반영한다는 것은 공동체를 중시한다는 것을 보여준다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② 공동체 중시: 열린 구조 → 자유로운 출입 → 소속감 → 공동체 중시
❌ ① 외부 침입 방어: 벽이 없으므로 방어 목적 아님
❌ ③ 종교 목적: 종교 언급 없음
❌ ④ 기술 부족: 의도적 설계(well-suited)
det.tip: mirrors values of openness and community = 개방성과 공동체 가치를 반영 → 의도적 설계
